suggestions.msg: Workflow is well-structured with proper concurrency controls, timeout, permissions, and environment-specific handling.
run_gh captures stderr in failure logs but not in success paths — when debugging a silent failure, stdout is lost.
suggestions.suggestion: Log r.stdout in the success path or make stdout available for post-mortem diagnosis.

suggestions.msg: OSError is the right exception for a missing binary, but it is also raised for other OS-level errors (permissions, ENOMEM, etc.) that may warrant different handling.
suggestions.suggestion: Catch FileNotFoundError specifically for the missing-binary case and re-raise or handle other OSError differently.

suggestions.msg: When the select-loop timeout fires and proc.kill() is called, the subsequent proc.wait(timeout=…) may have a negative remaining value; max(1, negative) defaults to 1 s instead of propagating the timeout signal.
suggestions.suggestion: Guard with: remaining = timeout - elapsed; if remaining <= 0: proc.kill(); proc.wait(); return None before the final wait call.

suggestions.msg: OSError is broad for the missing-binary case — also catches unrelated OS errors that may deserve different handling or logging.
suggestions.suggestion: Catch FileNotFoundError specifically; let other OSError propagate or log with higher severity.

suggestions.msg: Same timeout edge case as execute_implementation.py: if the select loop exhausts remaining time and proc.kill() fires, the final proc.wait(timeout=…) receives a negative remaining value clamped to 1 s.
suggestions.suggestion: Guard the final wait call with an elapsed-time check so negative remaining time is handled explicitly.

suggestions.msg: OSError is broad — FileNotFoundError is the specific case for a missing binary; other OS errors (ENOMEM, EPERM) may warrant different treatment.
suggestions.suggestion: Catch FileNotFoundError explicitly for the missing-binary case; log or re-raise other OSError variants differently.
